data.case_title: Street sales ban (Untersagung des Straßenverkaufs) from Ordnungsamt Berlin
data.title: Ban on selling food and drinks on the public sidewalk outside your snack bar
data.summary: The Ordnungsamt of Bezirksamt Beispiel-Spreebogen von Berlin has banned Yusuf Beispielkiez from selling food and drinks outside his snack bar "Spreebord Grill" on the public sidewalk, citing lack of a permit and obstruction of pedestrians found during checks on 28 October and 6 November 2026. An objection (Widerspruch) can be filed within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The district office has ordered you to stop selling outside your snack bar on the public sidewalk because you have no permit for this and pedestrian checks found the passage was blocked. You may decide whether to object (Widerspruch) to this decision; the app will show the deadline for that. If you take no action by then, the ban becomes final. You can keep operating inside the snack bar itself. If you believe you do have grounds to sell outside (e.g. a permit you already hold), consider getting advice before the deadline shown.
